selected.title: He Gave His Ex a Key to Our Apartment
selected.hook: My boyfriend gave his ex a key to our apartment and somehow thought I wouldn't mind.
selected.voiceover:
My boyfriend gave his ex a key to our apartment and somehow thought I wouldn't mind.

We'd lived together for eight months, and his ex had never really been a problem. They shared a dog years ago, stayed on friendly terms, and I honestly respected that they could be civil.

Then I came home early on Tuesday.

She was standing in our kitchen. Alone.

I asked how she got in, expecting some weird emergency.

She held up a key.

Apparently my boyfriend gave it to her three weeks earlier because she sometimes picked up old mail that still came to our address.

I called him immediately.

He said it was no big deal because she only used it when neither of us was home, and he'd forgotten to mention it.

That somehow made it worse.

This wasn't his apartment anymore. It was ours.

I asked why she couldn't just text before coming over, and he said giving her a key was easier than coordinating every time.

Then she casually mentioned she'd already been inside twice before.

So for three weeks, someone I barely know had unrestricted access to my home while I had no idea.

Now he's calling me controlling because I want the lock changed and the key back.

I don't care that she's his ex. I'd feel the same if it were anyone.

If you live with your partner, can you really hand out a key without asking them first?
